Name: Abiezer the Antothite
Summary: Valient man of David's armies and captain of the ninth month's course.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:28; 1 Chronicles 27:12: Valient man of David's armies and captain of the ninth month's course.
LifeLesson: The mention of Abiezer in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
